---
title: "Current Professional Activities"
---

<br>

I am currently co-chairing (with [Benjamin Côté](https://benjicote.github.io/benjicote/) and [Jay Sivathayalan](https://uwaterloo.ca/statistics-and-actuarial-science/contacts/jay-sivathayalan)) the [6th Waterloo Student Conference in Statistics, Actuarial Science, and Finance](https://uwaterloo.ca/statistics-actuarial-science-finance-student-conference/) ![](../assets/img/uw-logo-shield){height=17}!

* The conference will take place at the University of Waterloo on October 23--24, 2026.
* Submit an abstract [here](https://uwaterloo.ca/statistics-actuarial-science-finance-student-conference/abstract-submission) by Monday, September 14.
* Register [here](https://uwaterloo.ca/statistics-actuarial-science-finance-student-conference/registration) by Friday, October 9.

<br>

More generally, within the Department of Statistics and Actuarial Science at Waterloo:

* Since January 2025 I have been co-organizing (first with [Megan French](https://uwaterloo.ca/statistics-and-actuarial-science/contacts/megan-french), and now with [Madison Cranstone](https://uwaterloo.ca/statistics-and-actuarial-science/contacts/madison-cranstone)) a [Student Seminar Series](https://uwaterloo.ca/statistics-and-actuarial-science/student-seminar-series) designed to give grad students an opportunity to present their research.
We also occasionally invite professors to introduce their work to a student audience.
  - If you are interested in giving a talk, please [reach out](mailto:lsbumbul@uwaterloo.ca; me2french@uwaterloo.ca?subject=SAS Student Seminar Series)!
* In June 2025 I began a two-year term as grad student co-representative (with [Diribsa Bedada](https://uwaterloo.ca/statistics-and-actuarial-science/contacts/diribsa-tsegaye-bedada) for one year and [Victor Malinowski](https://victormalinowski.com/) for the other).
We facilitate communication between students, faculty, and staff in the department and represent the student perspective at department meetings.
